dimensions.note: No credentials or tokens. The config holds repo slugs, display names, and local workdir paths — none sensitive.
discoverConfig logs the loaded pair count and addRepoPair logs the derived id, using structured placeholders. No interpolation and no sensitive data.

readConfigFile now distinguishes an absent file (returns an empty config) from a present-but-malformed one (parse/validation errors propagate). This prevents a corrupt config from being silently treated as empty and then overwritten by the next write. Write errors propagate.

pr_sweep_config_test.ts covers deriveId (case, separators, leading/trailing dashes) and renderConfigSummary (empty state and a table row per pair, including the enabled flag). File I/O methods are not unit-tested.

addRepoPair derives a stable id from the name but does not check for an existing id, so adding a pair with a name already present creates a duplicate entry. removeRepoPair filters all entries with that id, so a duplicate is recoverable. Non-blocking; pre-existing behaviour.
No external HTTP or network calls; a local JSON file is the only interface.
Reads/writes one JSON file with Deno.readFile/writeFile; no handles, connections, or temp files to leak.
README uses example repos (Kilo-Org/kilocode, maphew/kilocode) and generic paths; no secrets or internal infrastructure identifiers.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); CEL validation works.
The config resource and summary file set lifetime 365d and garbageCollection 10, appropriate for durable operator configuration.
Full configuration surface: discover (read), addRepoPair, removeRepoPair (delete), toggleRepoPair, updateRepoPair.
No external mutation; the model only writes its local config file and data resources.
config-current and summary-current are unique and written by every method via discoverConfig.
The source of truth is the local JSON file; the model reads no stored swamp resources.
Bumped to 2026.10.14.1 with a no-op upgrades entry (source moved to swamp-extensions; no schema changes) so existing instances advance from the 2026.09.29.2 published baseline.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — ConfigSchema.repoPairs and RepoPairSchema fields are written by addRepoPair with defaults for optional fields; discoverConfig always writes the whole parsed config.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: na — no paginated or result-capped method.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — config-current and summary-current are written by every method with identical shape.
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — every declared field has a producing code path; notes is optional and absent unless set.
